title: A pick-and-pack dashboard that shows late orders before the customer asks
problem: Orders ship from three spreadsheets, so a late parcel is found only when the customer writes in. The team needs one live view of what is stuck and why, without replacing the tools they already use.
flow: Match each order to its pick list
Flag orders older than the promise
Show the queue on one screen

phases.name: Map
phases.deliverable: Order flow diagram and the list of late-order rules

phases.name: Hand over
phases.deliverable: Live dashboard, short guide, one week of support

risks.mitigation: Read through one adapter with a schema check
Keep the rules in one editable table

cta: Reply to this proposal and I will start the Map phase the same day.
